{{Quote|We're too big to fit in there.''"<br />"''No we're not. Watch this!|224 and the driver droid|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
An '[[AAT Driver Battle Droid/Legends|''AAT driver battle droid''']] was part of [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]' [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and participated in the [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|Battle of Rugosa]] under command of [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|battle droid commander]] [[224/Legends|224]] during a deal between [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]]. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] intervened and began destroying Ventress' droids, commander 224 and several of their droids were sent out to defeat him, with the winner of the ensuing battle gaining Katuunko's trust. During the battle, the droid driver was destroyed by Yoda, along with its tank.

==Biography==
===[[Rugosa]]===
{{Quote|I see him!|The droid concerning [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="Ambush" />
}}
The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] was an [[AAT Driver Battle Droid/Legends|AAT driver battle droid]] manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]] and [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] to serve in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was deployed amongst a [[T81 Division|battalion]] of battle droids to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], under the command of the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and the [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|battle droid commander]] [[224/Legends|224]]. The Separatists had learned that [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydaria]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] were [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|meeting]] in secret on the moon in order to discuss a Republic supply post being created on Toydaria in exchange for protection of the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] people. Ventress had managed to reach Katuunko first, and offered Separatist protection instead, but after she and the king learned that Yoda had successfully landed on the planet, an agreement was made. If Yoda could defeat her droid forces and reach Katuunko, he would have the allegiance of the Toydarians but if he failed they would side with the Separatists instead.<ref name="Ambush" />

[[File:AATDriversRugosa-Ambush.png|thumb|left|250px|Whilst on Rugosa the droid was lead by commander 224.]]
After arriving on the moon in a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]], commander 224 led a section of the droid forces including this driver to find and defeat Yoda, including three [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], one of which this droid rode in. Entering the coral forests of Rugosa, they soon sighted the Jedi Grand Master, who was accompanied by three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], nicknamed [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Thire/Legends|Thire]], [[Jek/Legends|Jek]] and [[Rys/Legends|Rys]], and ordered their troops to open fire. The Separatist forces were out of range, however, and 224 soon had to give the order to stop as the tanks could not fit through the surrounding foliage. This driver ignored the commander's order in the belief that the tanks could fit, but crashed and was thrown from its vehicle. As it recovered, it shouted back to 224 that they had been correct. As the vehicles could not continue, 224 remained behind while sending out ground troops to find the Republic forces. Yoda and his companions destroyed two patrols of B1 battle droids and a group of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], but were eventually driven back by [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="Ambush" />

As Yoda and his men retreated, 224 and their tanks were able to slowly advance through the coral and eventually entered a coral-free valley area in which the Republic forces had hidden. Alone, Yoda revealed himself to the droids and sat before them, meditating. 224 contacted Ventress via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], informing her of the development, and was ordered to attack the Jedi immediately. The Separatist forces opened fire but were too slow, as the Grand Master sprung forward and destroyed several of them before reaching 224's tank and cutting an entry hole in the bottom with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The tank's crew attempted to flee but were destroyed when Yoda pulled them back into the vehicle using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. 224 was then also pulled down from the command hatch and cut apart by Yoda's lightsaber. After Katuunko noticed the smoke rising from the skirmish, Ventress attempted to contact 224 for a report but was informed by another droid of their demise.<ref name="Ambush" />

Yoda continued to massacre the remaining droids, and soon managed to climb onto this droid's tank, making it accidentally shoot a friendly vehicle, killing several fellow droids. Yoda then carved a hole into the tank's top hatch and used the Force to propel the droid outside to its destruction. The droid was witnessed flying through the sky, still screaming, by Ventress and Katuunko before it finally hit the ground and was destroyed for good. Yoda was ultimately successful in defeating the remaining droid forces and reaching the rendezvous point, earning the allegiance of the Toydarians.<ref name="Ambush" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|You were right!"<br />"Next time, listen to orders!|The driver droid and 224|<ref name="Ambush" />
}}
Like all B1 battle droids within the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], the driver stood at 1.93 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Battle Droid" /> and had [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] programming<ref name="Battle droids gender" />. Created for the purpose of both combat and driving, it sported [[Color/Legends|tan-colored]] plating with brown markings indicating its rank as a driver. The droid ignored orders from its superior and engaged in reckless activities in order to prove that it was correct.<ref name="Ambush" />

==Behind the scenes==
The droid driver's first and only appearance was in the first episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], ''[[Ambush]]'', that aired in [[2008]]. Like all battle droids in the series, it was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]].
